subject.title: [Feature]: Per-user heartbeat routing for channel-level heartbeat messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a WhatsApp/channel-account heartbeat recipient contract for OK acknowledgments only, and what public shape should it use?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but the fix adds public config surface and must define precedence, validation, and the boundary between agent heartbeat delivery and channel visibility.

options.title: Approve OK-only recipient config
options.body: Add a narrow channel/account recipient shape, such as `target` or `targets`, that only changes `HEARTBEAT_OK` delivery and validates through WhatsApp account/allowlist policy.

options.title: Reject new config surface
options.body: Keep the current contract and document the existing choices: disable OK visibility with `showOk: false` or route all heartbeat delivery with agent-level `heartbeat.target` and `to`.

options.title: Defer to cross-channel design
options.body: Keep this as design input while maintainers choose a broader heartbeat recipient model instead of a WhatsApp-specific field.

recommendation.title: Approve OK-only recipient config
recommendation.body: Add a narrow channel/account recipient shape, such as `target` or `targets`, that only changes `HEARTBEAT_OK` delivery and validates through WhatsApp account/allowlist policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest combined signal from prior issue discussion and recent heartbeat/outbound routing history.
